meta.name: add-webex
meta.description: Add Webex channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 在应用中集成Webex聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在应用里接入Webex聊天功能。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Webex chat into your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Webex chat to your app.

howto.what: 它把 Webex 通道适配器从 channels 分支复制进项目、注册到通道入口,并安装依赖包,再构建并跑注册测试。机器人凭据和 Webhook 仍需你在 Webex 开发者门户手动配置。
howto.when: 当你要求给项目添加 Webex 通道集成时接管:复制适配器、注册并安装依赖、构建并跑测试。

say.text: 给这个项目加上 Webex 通道集成。
say.note: 会执行复制、注册、装依赖、构建和测试。

say.text: 跑一下 webex 注册测试,看看适配器装好没有。
say.note: 测试变红说明入口导入或依赖出了问题。

say.text: Webex 空间里的消息收不到,帮我排查 webhook。
say.note: 会检查 webhook 地址、状态和签名密钥。

howto.what_en: It copies the Webex adapter from the channels branch into src/channels/, registers it in the channel barrel, installs @bitbasti/chat-adapter-webex@0.1.0, then builds and runs the registration test. Bot credentials and webhook setup stay manual.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to add Webex channel integration to the project; it takes over copying the adapter, registering and installing the dependency, and building plus testing.

say_en.text: Add Webex channel integration to this project.
say_en.note: Copies, registers, installs, builds and tests.

say_en.text: Run the webex registration test to check the adapter.
say_en.note: Red means the barrel import or dependency drifted.

say_en.text: Messages in my Webex space never arrive; check the webhook.
say_en.note: Checks webhook URL, state and signature secret.
